propositions: _paged_search lacks offset-stall detection and spins infinitely when a DC server ignores/repeats startAt offsets without advancing, exiting only on external harness cap (observed: 26 calls)
get_parent_map wraps _paged_search in a bare except Exception handler that converts any pager abort into silent empty degradation, neutralizing loud stall signals
fetch_snapshot's three enrichment handlers (parent, comment, issuelink) wrap the three whole-project DC readers in broad except Exception fail-opens that swallow stall errors at the fetcher boundary
the stall guard must track previous page identity and raise on ANY repeated page, not just short pages, because DC's hardened page-cap makes short pages the normal case with more data to give
four re-raise sites are required (get_parent_map + three fetch_snapshot handlers) for the stall error to propagate past all fail-open boundaries to the reconciler pass
